questions.question: How many maximum electrons can M shell have?
questions.questionHtml: How many maximum electrons can M shell have?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 18.

Key Points

  • Concept:
    • The distribution of electrons into different orbits of an atom was suggested by Bohr and Bury.
    • The orbits or shells are represented by the letters K, L, M, N,… or the numbers, n = 1, 2, 3, 4.
    • The following rules are followed for writing the number of electrons in different energy levels or shells:
    • The maximum number of electrons present in a shell is given by the formula 2n2, where ‘n’ is the orbit number or energy level index. 
  • Calculation:
    • Given:
    • Shell given = M, orbit number = 3.
    • The maximum number of electrons present in a shell is given by the formula 2n2.
    • Therefore, 2 × 32 = 18

Total work = 39 × 20 = 780 units

Time = 780/39 ⇒ 20 days

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: It has been raining since morning. 

Key Points 

  • Let us look at the meaning of the given prepositions.
    • Till: Up to the point in time or the event mentioned. (समय तक या उल्लिखित घटना तक)
    • From: Indicates the point in time at which a particular process, event, or activity starts. (उस समय को इंगित करना जिस पर एक विशेष प्रक्रिया, घटना या गतिविधि शुरू होती है)
    • By: Identifies the agent performing an action. (कार्रवाई करने वाले एजेंट की पहचान करना)
    • Since: From a particular time in the past until a later time, or until now. (अतीत में किसी विशेष समय से बाद के समय तक, या अब तक)
      • For example- I haven't eaten since breakfast.
  • The given sentence is saying that the rain has started in the morning and it is still continuing.
  • We use since as a preposition, a conjunction and an adverb to refer to a time, and as a conjunction to introduce a reason.
  • So, as per the meaning of the given prepositions "since" should be used here.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.solution: The correct answer is option 2: "He was laughed at by all his friends."
